requirements.desc: The `get.resolve-context` registry definition shall accept `--expect-run-id`, `--expect-issue`, and `--expect-spec` through the existing `FLOW_TARGET_GUARD_OPTIONS`, and its command help shall display the same three options with unit-tested help/dispatcher parity.
requirements.note: R1: exposes identical target guard options through registry dispatch and help

requirements.desc: CLI-dispatched resolve-context shall return the existing successful resolved-context payload when all supplied run ID, Issue, and spec guards match, and shall return an envelope with error code `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` when any one of those guards differs from the selected active flow.
requirements.note: R2: accepts matching guards and rejects each mismatching guard with ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH

requirements.desc: Resolve-context calls without target guards shall continue to succeed, and the implementation shall add no resolve-context-specific comparison, `targetGuard` exception, or other bypass of the existing `FlowCommand` and flow-context validation path.
requirements.note: R3: preserves guard-free dispatch and inherited shared target validation
